name: Suite Morning
description: A hotel suite wakes up to an ocean view, from curtains to balcony coffee.

screenplay.title: Suite Morning
screenplay.brief: A boutique hotel ad about the perfect first morning. A drone reveals the hotel and its coastline, a guest wakes in the sunlit suite, coffee waits on the terrace, and she steps out to take in the ocean.
screenplay.style_bible: Luxury travel commercial, natural morning light from frame right, soft airy whites and sand tones with a deep blue sea, golden glow, gentle slow camera moves, shallow depth of field.

shots.action: A drone shot starts close above the sea-facing terrace of the small white limestone hotel: two open white French doors with sheer curtains, the bistro table, the olive tree and the white balustrade at the cliff edge, the deep blue sea beyond. No people.

camera.framing: aerial shot widening to an extreme wide shot
camera.movement: one long drone move that pulls far back and rises, zooming out from the terrace to the whole cliff, bay and coastline

shots.action: On the limestone terrace a white ceramic cup of coffee with a thin curl of steam and a single golden croissant on a white plate rest on the round black bistro table, the calm blue sea behind. Nobody in the shot.
The guest sits up in the king bed against the white pillows, smiling softly as she turns her face toward the open doors and the light.

camera.movement: static, very slow drift to the right

shots.action: The guest stands at the limestone balustrade with her back to the camera, holding the coffee cup, looking out over the calm blue sea in the morning sun.

camera.movement: slow crane up and back to reveal the coast
